overview_description.description: Starburst is a data platform utilizing a lakehouse architecture with Trino and Apache Iceberg, designed to enhance AI development and analytics. The company acts as an analytics engine that allows organizations to query data across various databases, making data instantly actionable. Starburst offers a fully-managed analytics platform for managing massive data sets in cloud data lakes, enabling effective data discovery and analysis.
